title: DaVinci Resolve Studio: 10 AI Tools Demonstrated with Timed Techniques
summary: This video showcases ten AI-enabled features directly built into DaVinci Resolve Studio, demonstrated in a practical editing workflow. The presenter traverses a workflow from masking and background composite using the Magic Mask (with a Fusion-based setup) to speed up heavy rotoscoping tasks, through AI-powered transcription and keyword-driven editing for efficient referencing, and into automated subtitling. The guide then covers voice-based tools for post-production, including AI voice training for voice conversion and AI voice isolation to clean dialogue, followed by several music-centric AI features for editing and timing. Additional acceleration comes from AI-powered ripple delete for silences, a Smooth Cut transition to bridge gaps, and AI-driven speed warp for retiming video. Across these sections, the video emphasizes saving hours of manual work and enabling rapid iteration when edits require last-minute changes or alignment to music and beats. The transcript anchors each section to exact DaVinci Resolve actions and settings, providing a concrete, timestamped map of the tools demonstrated.
